# PolarTrajectorySpiking

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method for encoding polar coordinate trajectories as sequences of spikes on neuromorphic hardware, leveraging angular and radial components. Enables efficient representation of spatial paths in spiking networks, critical for robotics and navigation tasks in iNEST systems.
